command.donbass.usage: Donbass commands: /donbasshelp - the guide; /donbass bosshp [multiplier] - the boss health multiplier.
command.donbass.bosshp.current: Boss health multiplier: x%1$s (a new boss gets %2$s HP).
command.donbass.bosshp.usage: Usage: /donbass bosshp <multiplier> - a number with a decimal point from %1$s to %2$s, for example 1.5 (operators only).
command.donbass.bosshp.set: Boss health multiplier set to x%1$s: the next boss will have %2$s HP. A boss that already stands is not changed.
command.donbass.bosshp.no_permission: Only operators (OP) can change the boss health multiplier. Read it with /donbass bosshp, the guide is /donbasshelp.
command.donbass.bosshp.error.empty: No multiplier given. Usage: /donbass bosshp <multiplier>, for example /donbass bosshp 1.5 (from %2$s to %3$s, decimal point).
command.donbass.bosshp.error.format: "%1$s" is not a number. Usage: /donbass bosshp <multiplier>, for example /donbass bosshp 1.5 (from %2$s to %3$s, decimal point).
command.donbass.bosshp.error.comma: Use a dot, not a comma: /donbass bosshp 1.5 (you typed "%1$s").
command.donbass.bosshp.error.negative: The multiplier must be positive (you typed "%1$s"). Usage: /donbass bosshp <multiplier>, from %2$s to %3$s.
command.donbass.bosshp.error.zero: The multiplier cannot be zero. Usage: /donbass bosshp <multiplier>, from %2$s to %3$s.
command.donbass.bosshp.error.min: "%1$s" is too small: the lowest multiplier is %2$s. Usage: /donbass bosshp <multiplier>, from %2$s to %3$s.
command.donbass.bosshp.error.max: "%1$s" is too large: the highest multiplier is %3$s (the game limits health to 1024). Usage: /donbass bosshp <multiplier>, from %2$s to %3$s.
command.donbass.help.title: === Donbass: guide ===
command.donbass.help.footer: One block only: /donbasshelp factions | weapons | world | boss | bosshp | coop
command.donbass.help.factions.title: Factions and NPCs
command.donbass.help.factions.1: Miners: peaceful traders; they sell for Miner's Tokens and offer more as their level grows. Hit one and it hits back, and its mates help.
command.donbass.help.factions.2: DPR and LPR militiamen: hostile riflemen (recruit, fighter, sergeant) at checkpoints, plants, stations and deep mines.
command.donbass.help.factions.3: The two squads also shoot at each other (switch off in the config: factionsFight). They drop rounds, parts and pieces of their uniform.
command.donbass.help.weapons.title: Weapons and combat
command.donbass.help.weapons.1: AK rifle: hold Use to fire, Shift + Use to reload (rounds come from your inventory). You shoot more accurately while sneaking.
command.donbass.help.weapons.2: Weapon Workbench: installs up to five AK modifications, one of each kind - magazine, reload, stabilizer, barrel, spring.
command.donbass.help.weapons.3: Armour: miner's clothes and coal armour (full-set bonuses), DPR and LPR military uniforms.
command.donbass.help.world.title: The world
command.donbass.help.world.1: Donbass Travel Voucher: Use it in the Overworld to go to the Donbass dimension, and there to come back.
command.donbass.help.world.2: Mines: shallow (hard hats and tools), active (miner's clothes, parts), deep (coal armour, weapon parts, a rare AK).
command.donbass.help.world.3: Settlements, plants and freight stations: loot, miners and sometimes fighters. A rare Administration building holds the boss siren.
command.donbass.help.world.4: A checkpoint is held by one squad and flies its flag: DPR (black, blue, red) or LPR (light blue, blue, red). Its chests hold rounds, magazines and that squad's uniform.
command.donbass.help.boss.title: The boss: Chairman of the Coal Region
command.donbass.help.boss.1: He never appears on his own. His siren calls him: Use it on open ground (it is used up). It does not work on Peaceful, or if another Chairman is within 160 blocks.
command.donbass.help.boss.2: Siren: craft it (2 coal plates, bell, 2 rifle magazines, anthracite block, 2 weapon parts, diamond - plate, bell, plate / magazine, block, magazine / parts, diamond, parts) or find it in the Administration building.
command.donbass.help.boss.3: Three phases (below 66%% and 33%% of his health); he is invulnerable for about 3 seconds while changing phase. Bring armour, rounds and friends.
command.donbass.help.boss.4: Rewards: the Chairman's Pickaxe and Badge of Merit, tokens, diamonds, coal plates, rounds and parts.
command.donbass.help.bosshp.title: Boss health: /donbass bosshp
command.donbass.help.bosshp.1: Sets the multiplier of the boss's maximum health (default 1.0). Only operators (OP) can change it; everybody can read it.
command.donbass.help.bosshp.2: It applies to a boss summoned after the change; a boss that already stands keeps his health. Damage and behaviour do not change.
command.donbass.help.bosshp.3: Allowed: 0.1 to 3.2 with a decimal point (the game caps health at 1024); the value is saved with the world.
command.donbass.help.bosshp.ex3: /donbass bosshp 1.5 - one and a half times
command.donbass.help.coop.title: Co-op: recommended boss health
command.donbass.help.coop.6: These are approximate values: change them to suit your gear and the damage your group deals. Set them with /donbass bosshp before summoning the boss.
